mapper.select: SELECT source, last_id, done, report, lease_owner FROM learning_event_backfill WHERE source = #{source}
mapper.update: UPDATE learning_event_backfill SET lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE) WHERE source = #{source} AND done = 0 AND (lease_owner IS NULL OR lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < NOW() OR lease_owner = #{owner})

UPDATE learning_event_backfill SET last_id = #{lastId}, report = #{report}, lease_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE) WHERE source = #{source} AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND lease_until >= NOW()
UPDATE learning_event_backfill SET done = 1, report = #{report}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE source = #{source} AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND lease_until >= NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT t.topic_id FROM course_topics t WHERE t.topic_id = #{topicId} AND t.user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT topic_progress_id FROM topic_progress WHERE topic_id = #{topicId} AND user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT link_id FROM material_links WHERE link_id = #{linkId} AND user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_contexts c LEFT JOIN learning_event_origins o ON o.user_id = c.user_id AND o.origin_kind = 'USER_CONTEXT' AND o.origin_id = c.context_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.course_id = #{courseId} AND c.created_at < #{before} -- 기록기 대상과 같게: 살아 있는 행 + 해결 연결이 있는 대체된 막힘(STUCK을 유지한다) AND (c.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'STALE') OR (c.fact_kind = 'DIFFICULTY' AND c.status = 'SUPERSEDED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learning_resolution_links k WHERE k.user_id = c.user_id AND k.difficulty_context_id = c.context_id))) AND (c.fact_kind IN ('PROGRESS', 'EXAM_SCOPE', 'DIFFICULTY', 'RESOLVED') OR c.source_type = 'SELF_CHECK') AND COALESCE(o.current_revision, 0) = 0 -- 막힘에 이어진 해결 기억은 자기 origin이 아니라 RESOLUTION(막힘 id)에 쓴다 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learning_resolution_links l JOIN learning_event_origins r ON r.user_id = l.user_id AND r.origin_kind = 'RESOLUTION' AND r.origin_id = l.difficulty_context_id AND r.current_revision > 0 WHERE l.user_id = c.user_id AND l.resolver_context_id = c.context_id)

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_scope_exclusions x LEFT JOIN learning_event_origins o ON o.user_id = x.user_id AND o.origin_kind = 'SCOPE_EXCLUSION' AND o.origin_id = x.exclusion_id WHERE x.user_id = #{userId} AND x.course_id = #{courseId} AND x.created_at < #{before} AND x.status = 'ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(o.current_revision, 0) = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM topic_class_progress p LEFT JOIN learning_event_origins o ON o.user_id = p.user_id AND o.origin_kind = 'CLASS_PROGRESS' AND o.origin_id = p.progress_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.course_id = #{courseId} AND p.created_at < #{before} AND COALESCE(o.current_revision, 0) = 0)

SELECT t.topic_id AS id, t.user_id FROM course_topics t LEFT JOIN topic_progress p ON p.topic_id = t.topic_id AND p.user_id = t.user_id WHERE t.topic_id > #{afterId} AND (#{onlyUser} IS NULL OR t.user_id = #{onlyUser}) AND ((p.status = 'LEARNED' AND p.created_at < #{before}) OR (t.user_mark = 'KNOWN' AND t.created_at < #{before})) ORDER BY t.topic_id LIMIT #{limit}
